snippet.title: SCP: Short Story - Trailer (EN)
snippet.description:
SCP: Short Story is a first-person shooter set in a world where the K-class scenario destroyed almost every living form. You’ll have to get through this dead world, retrieve essential documents from Site-17, and most importantly, do not get killed by what survived.

[UA] - https://youtu.be/Pc_AwEr2qs8

Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3635310/SCP_Short_Story/

Credits:
1) Music - Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio - Sanity Unravels
